findings.resolution: Corrected scripts/build_chapter_14.py's Debug Lab 6 terminal_transcript and explanation to describe the actual silent-overwrite behavior (krug.radius=5 then print(krug.radius) prints 5, no exception), verified against Python 3.14.6.
